summary.headline: Porphyry Chapter List and Missing Chapters
summary.text: Catalog of chapters 54–71 from Masala and Porphyry, covering the sixth place, enclosure, houses or zones, exaltations, stellar rulership, testimony, reception, applications, separations, intervention, decanates, overcoming, void of course, and rays. It notes that chapters 72–112 are missing, listing topics including signs, astrolabe methods, sect, comets, trigon-rulers, prominent stars, and the twelve places of Masala, with chapters 55–71 excerpted from Porphyry’s Isagoge.
